19:class ComfortConflictResolver {
20:    fun resolve(actions: List<ComfortAction>): Pair<List<ComfortAction>, List<RejectedComfortAction>> {
21:        val accepted = mutableListOf<ComfortAction>()
22:        val rejected = mutableListOf<RejectedComfortAction>()
23:        actions.groupBy { it.kind to it.zone }.values.forEach { candidates ->
24:            val ranked = candidates.sortedWith(
25:                compareByDescending<ComfortAction> { it.priority }
26:                    .thenBy { it.expiresAfter }
27:                    .thenBy { it.rationale },
28:            )
29:            val winner = ranked.first()
30:            accepted += winner
31:            ranked.drop(1).forEach { loser ->
32:                val reason = if (loser.priority == winner.priority) {
33:                    "Equal-priority action superseded by deterministic policy order"
34:                } else {
35:                    "Lower priority than ${winner.rationale}"
36:                }
37:                rejected += RejectedComfortAction(loser, reason)
38:            }
39:        }
40:        return accepted.sortedWith(compareByDescending<ComfortAction> { it.priority }.thenBy { it.kind }) to rejected
41:    }
